entry.title: Kärnan
entry.note: Exact-QID OSM main footprint, including the offset stair turret, supplies anchor and axis. Hikuin19, pp44–45 explicitly locates the stair turret on the southwest face and the privy projection on the northwest. Native -X is southwest and -Z northwest under the recorded heading; native +Z is southeast. The source preserves that signed frame. The main footprint and signed facade orientation are map/publication based. Ground levels, the reconstructed collar wall and timber stair need detailed site terrain and survey confirmation. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
